greeting: Good morning, Zae. Friday in Tallahassee looks dry and mild with a high near 81F, your calendar is the usual supplements, and the ship sails in 2 days.

events.title: Morning Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine, L-Theanine, two Omega soft gels, Vitamin D3 + K2, and B-Complex.
Afternoon Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine and one or two Omega soft gels.
Night Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Theanine and three Neuro-Mag capsules. Creatine 5g any time today.

projectMove.title: Keep Arena Phase 24 rolling, then lock the cruise bag
projectMove.body: Phase 24 of the Arena Battlegrounds remake is still incomplete and running on Sol Max after overnight usage resets; Testarossa keeps resuming on her own and reports finishes through me. With the Tallahassee bus leaving tomorrow night, today is the last quiet weekday to finish packing and confirm the Carnival boarding PDF is on your phone.

tip.title: Put boarding group C02 and the Cozumel day clothes where you can grab them
tip.body: Tomorrow night is the Tallahassee bus, then Tampa embark on Sunday with boarding group C02 and an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival window. Keep the boarding-pass PDF, ID, and Cozumel shore-day clothes in one easy pocket of the Dockers duffel so you are not digging through the bag at the terminal.

extras.cruiseNote: The trip runs October 31 to November 5. The Tallahassee bus leaves Saturday night, October 31, the ship sails from Tampa on November 1 with an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival and boarding group C02, and Cozumel on November 3 (about 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM) is the one shore day.
extras.weatherNote: Clear and mild this morning near 65F, warming to a high near 81F with almost no chance of rain.

surprise.title: Jazzmatazz at Blue Tavern, 8 to 11 PM
surprise.body: Your calendar holds Russian study from 6 to 8 tonight, so the early Halloween shows collide with it, but this one starts right as you close the books. Blues-rooted vocalist Samantha Carston sings with the Michael Bakan Trio at Blue Tavern, 1206 N Monroe St, from 8 to 11 PM, with a $10 cover. The forecast is dry and overcast, about 73°F at 8 PM and 71°F by 10, so it is an easy night out. One quiet jazz evening before the bus, and two days to sailing.
